title: HAAY HUSSAIN WAWAILA
body:
Khoon se maqtal Laal hua hai
Ibne Hasan paamaal hua hai
Laashe ka kya haal hua hai
Tukde tukde hai Dulha
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Noore nazar ghode se gira hai
Sheh ne kamar ko thaam liya hai
BaapPisar ko dhoond raha hai
Hanste hain sab ahle jafa
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe Jawa'n seene se laga kar
Laate hain maidaan se Sarwar
Dekh rahi hai Maa ye manzar
Gham se na marjaaye Laila
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaan e hazeen par jor o sitam hai
Daagh PisarBhai ka alam hai
Aankhein pur khoon dil pur nam hai
Haatho'n pa Asghar ka Laasha
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghere hain Bekas ko sitamgar
Paas nahi'n Abbas e Dilawar
Koi nahi'n Mazloom ka yawar
Kis ko dein Shabbir Sada
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil me basi hai Yaad e Sakina
Maut ka hai maathe pa pasina
Pyaas ki shiddat jalta seena
Yaad hai Dukhiya ka rona
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Goonj rahi Zehra ki fugha'n hai
Tegho'n me Ahmed ka Nasha'n hai
HaayMera Abbas kaha'n hai
Pyaase ka kat'ta hai gala
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Zakhmo'n se sab khoon rawa'n hai
Dil me Ghame farzandeJawan hai
Pyaase ke aankho'n me dhua'n hai
Ghere hai lashkar aadaa ka
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Tapta maatal jalti zami'n hai
Khaliq ke Sajde me jabi'n hai
Yaawaro Nasir koi nahi'n hai
Tegh tale Pyaase ka gala
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaane Ali begoro kafan hai
Zainab ke Baazu me rasan hai
Balwe me Sarwar ki Bahan hai
Aale Nabi hai beparda
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaasi hai Aulaade Payambar
Aada ka sairaab hai Lashkar
Pyaasi Sakina Pyaasa Asghar
Saamne behta hai dariya
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Karna hai Mazloom ki Nusrat
Laazim hai Sarwar ki Itaa'at
Ek hai bas ummeede shifa'at
Maatam karlo Bekas ka
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Sarwar ka Gham dil me basa hai
Dhadkan kya hai aaho buka hai
Majlis e Gham Zainab ki ataa hai
Maatam hai Zehra ki Dua
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Parwaane Shabbir ke hain ham
Saath liye Abbas ka Parcham
Karte hain Pyaaso'n ka Maatam
Dete hain Zehra ko pursa
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Hota hai jab Shabbir ka Maatam
Gham se laraz jaate hain do Aalam
Karbobala ke rann se paiham
Aati hai Halmin ki sada
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda hain Jaweed yunhi ham
Apna jeena Sarwar ka Gham
Naam e Ali har zakhm ka marham
Haasil hai Zehra ki Dua
<<MINI>>
Haay Hussain Wawaila
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
